requirements.requirement: Predict conservative descendant path pressure before choosing the inline SwiftPM workspace.
Select a short deterministic per-package SwiftPM scratch path for deep Windows packages.
Preserve short-package, non-Windows, and explicit --scratch-path behavior.
Warn actionably when an operator-selected scratch root still exceeds the safe budget.
Keep disk-space leasing and cleanup explicit follow-on work; path shortening must not be represented as lifecycle ownership.
